descriptions.en: Shows the current NetEase Cloud Music track in the notch tray: album art, scrolling lyrics, progress, and previous / play-pause / next controls. Optional online lyrics. Requires NetEase Cloud Music and macOS Automation permission.
descriptions.zh-Hans: 在刘海托盘显示网易云当前曲目：封面、滚动歌词、进度条和上一曲/播放暂停/下一曲。可选在线歌词。需要已安装网易云音乐并授予自动化权限。

summaries.en: Now-playing widget for NetEase Cloud Music with lyrics and controls.
summaries.zh-Hans: 刘海屏网易云音乐播放器：封面、同步歌词与播放控制。
